title: GH Ship Release Artifact
description: The public protocol between a GitHub Actions release workflow and GH Ship. A workflow uploads this document as `ship.release.json` inside the `ship-release` artifact; GH Ship reads it to render the Release PR and create the GitHub Release.

$schema.description: Editor metadata only. gh-ship reads `schemaVersion` to decide how to read this document and ignores this field entirely.

schemaVersion.description: Authoritative protocol version. GH Ship refuses documents whose version it does not understand.

changed.description: Whether there is anything to release. When false, GH Ship prints `nothing to release`, exits 0, and touches no branch, PR or release.

version.description: The version being released, in whatever scheme the project uses. GH Ship never parses or validates this beyond requiring a non-empty single-line string — it does not know how your project versions itself.

tag.description: The git tag to create. Must not contain whitespace. GH Ship does not derive this from `version`; the workflow owns the tag convention.

release.description: GitHub Release content. Every field is optional; GH Ship falls back to its configured templates.

name.description: Release title. Defaults to the tag when omitted.

notes.description: Release body, in GitHub Flavored Markdown. GH Ship never generates this — use git-cliff, release-drafter, or whatever your project already uses.

prerelease.description: Mark the GitHub Release as a pre-release.

make_latest.description: Whether this release should be marked as the repository's latest.

pull_request.description: Release PR overrides. Every field is optional; GH Ship falls back to its configured templates.

body.description: Complete PR body. When set, GH Ship uses it verbatim and skips header/notes/footer assembly.

labels.description: Labels to apply to the Release PR, in addition to those configured.

allOf.$comment: A changed release must identify itself.
